description: A wether (ram) wearing a brass bell on a collar leading a flock of sheep across a green pasture.
Close-up of a paper absentee ballot and its official return envelope on a table.
A voter dropping a sealed mail ballot envelope into an official secure ballot drop box outdoors.
A queue of voters outside an American polling place on a November morning, "VOTE HERE" sign visible.
Black-and-white style photograph of delegates from Asian and African nations seated at a long conference table, Bandung 1955.
Portrait of Jawaharlal Nehru in a white Gandhi cap and light sherwani jacket with a rose in the buttonhole, 1950s.
Portrait of Gamal Abdel Nasser in a dark suit waving to a crowd, 1960s Egyptian president.
Portrait of Queen Elizabeth II wearing a diamond tiara, blue sash and order insignia, formal royal portrait.
Group photograph of Commonwealth heads of government in suits and traditional dress standing in rows at a summit.
Black-and-white portrait photograph of Hans Morgenthau, a middle-aged scholar with glasses in a suit, 1950s.
Formal oil-painting style portrait of US President James Monroe in early 19th-century dress.
Black-and-white photograph of Charles Lindbergh speaking at a podium with microphones before a huge indoor rally crowd, 1941.
Portrait of George Washington in the style of the Gilbert Stuart painting, in a dark coat with white cravat.
Wide view of the United Nations General Assembly hall in New York, delegates seated in curved rows before a large UN emblem.
Sepia-toned photograph of a 1910s American women's suffrage parade, women in white dresses carrying "VOTES FOR WOMEN" banners.
Black-and-white photograph of Emmeline Pankhurst being carried away by a police officer during her arrest outside Buckingham Palace, 1914.
A 1980s London stock exchange trading floor with dealers in period dress and early computer screens.
A modern stock exchange trading floor with large electronic screens showing share prices and graphs.
Editorial cartoon style illustration of a duck with a bandaged wing using a crutch, in front of a government building.
A Cold War-era world map coloured to show the rival American-led and Soviet-led blocs in contrasting colours.
